Fume extractor

Layers, front to back

How it holds together

  • Face: no screws. A 3 mm lip drops into the front pad pocket, and 4 Ø6 × 2 magnets hold it on. Pull it off to swap the pad.
  • Front stack: , from the front of L5 into heat-set inserts in L3. The face hides them.
  • Back stack: , from the back into L3.
  • Fan: clamped between the L3 back ring and L4's ribs. It needs no screws.
  • Handle: 2 × M4 screws, fitted from inside the fan pocket before the fan goes in.
  • Wiring: the fan lead drops into the hollow chin through a notch in L3, then runs to the jack and switch on L4's right side.

Measure before printing

  • Handle: hole spacing, thread size, foot size64 mm and M4 assumed
  • Carbon pad: thickness and sheet size88 mm sq × 10 assumed
  • Fan: is it 12 V or 24 V? The adaptor tops out at 12 V.
  • DC jack: panel hole sizeØ8 assumed
  • Switch: type and hole sizeØ6 toggle assumed
  • Heat-set insert length≤ 6 assumed
